messages:
sam: Heads-up team: planning a staged rollout for service-x at 11:00 UTC. Need final internal note, canary plan, and rollback commands. RN draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/rn/service-x.

anya: I can condense the RN into a short internal blurb. Will call out the DB migration + feature flag.

mike: DB migration is a lightweight index add, expected <2m but could cause brief 503s. Recommend migration window 11:05-11:08 UTC.

sam: Good. Add a short sentence: "If you see 503s beyond 2m, trigger rollback."

oncall-rita: I'll be oncall for this window. Rollback criteria proposal: 4xx/5xx combined >3% sustained for 5m OR error budget burn >20% in 10m.

szabo: For safety let's keep canary at 3% for first 10m, then 30% for 10m, then ramp to 100% if stable. Document the exact deploy-bot job name.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by sam: job id deploy/service-x/2026-03-22-11. Canary schedule: 3% @ T0, 30% @ T0+10m, 100% @ T0+20m. To cancel use `/deploy cancel deploy/service-x/2026-03-22-11`.

anya: Draft internal blurb: "Planned rollout: service-x starting 11:00 UTC. Expect a short DB migration at ~11:05 UTC (1-2m). Oncall: @oncall-rita. Canary: 3% -> 30% -> 100%. Rollback triggers: sustained >3% 4xx/5xx for 5m or >20% error budget burn in 10m. Rollback command included in RN."

mike: Add note about stale read behavior for 30-90s during migration. People need to know product signals may show transient mismatch.

oncall-rita: Confirmed. I'll monitor the error graph linked in the RN and escalate if threshold crossed. Also pre-warm cache after migration.

sam: Add exact rollback snippet to RN ops section: ```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback deploy/service-x@previous
```

anya: I'll post the internal announcement in #general 3 minutes before start and tag eng, product, growth. Draft message ready.

szabo: One more: pin the service version in the RN: v2.4.7 (do not infer auto upgrades).

sam: Final checklist: RN updated (anya), announcement queued (anya), oncall confirmed (oncall-rita), deploy queued (deploy-bot), rollback snippet added (sam). If no objections, proceed.

anya: RN updated and announcement queued.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deployment starts in 5 minutes. To abort: `/deploy cancel deploy/service-x/2026-03-22-11`.

oncall-rita: Ready and watching.

sam: Thanks all, proceeding on schedule. :rocket:
